subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: User Testing with Disabled Users
description: A quick win: understand User Testing with Disabled Users.

hook.text: A team audits their own site for accessibility. They declare it accessible. Real disabled users disagree.

buildup.text: User testing with people who have disabilities reveals barriers that audits and tools overlook.

discovery.text: Testing with real users shows actual usage patterns: unexpected navigation strategies and workarounds.

twist.text: Users who rely on assistive tech daily are experts in its capabilities. They find issues testers never considered.

climax.text: Five disabled users test the app. They find 15 barriers the audit missed, all impacting daily usability.

punchline.text: Nothing replaces real users. Include disabled testers in every cycle.

quiz.question: Why include disabled users in testing?
options: They find real-world barriers that audits and tools miss
